workflows.editor.removeBody: The step goes from the YAML, with any comment above it. Steps whose fix rounds name it will need another.
workflows.editor.resetBody: {{file}} is removed from the workspace, and {{tier}} tasks run the app's workflow. Runs under way keep the copy they started with.
workflows.editor.leaveBody: The changes to this workflow are lost.
workflows.editor.title: {{tier}} workflow
workflows.editor.appsCopy: the app's (not saved in the project)
workflows.editor.valid: Valid: a {{tier}} run can use it as written.
workflows.editor.describeHelp: Claude rewrites this workflow from your description, starting from what's in the editor. It's checked like one you write; nothing is saved until you keep it and Save.
workflows.editor.describePlaceholder: e.g. Plan with the architect, have a test planner list the tests first, then implement, then a security review before the gates.
workflows.editor.selectHint: Select a step on the canvas or in the list to edit it.
workflows.editor.xlFixed: XL's split, sub-tasks and integration gates are fixed in shape.
workflows.editor.newStepsAfter: New steps go after the selected one.
workflows.stepForm.subtasksHelp: Each sub-task runs its own tier's workflow in its own worktree (1–4).
workflows.stepForm.integrationGates: Integration gates, on the merged task branch
workflows.stepForm.sendFindingsBack: Send must-fix findings back to a write step
workflows.stepForm.backToStep: The write step that gets the failures
workflows.stepForm.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; fix rounds name steps by it.
workflows.stepForm.label: Label
workflows.stepForm.groupHelp: Its members run at the same time, read-only, and their answers merge into the plan. Select a member to edit it.
workflows.stepForm.accessReadOnly: Parallel members and the split are read-only.
workflows.stepForm.accessHelp: Read: Read, Grep and Glob only. Write: the normal tools, with approvals.
workflows.stepForm.outputHelp: plan: kept as plan.md for later steps. review: findings, read-only steps only.
workflows.stepForm.fresh: A fresh session that sees only its inputs
workflows.canvas.fixUsedTitle: Fix rounds used: {{used}} of {{max}}. Failures go back to {{back}}.
workflows.canvas.fixMaxTitle: Up to {{max}} fix rounds: failures go back to {{back}}.
workflows.canvas.empty: Nothing to draw: the YAML isn't a workflow yet.
